I am an old woman now, sixty-one years, and this small beans plot is close to my house where I can watch it. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — they feed themselves from the soil, my mother taught me this long ago. I will put a little manure from my goats because I have it at home costing me nothing, and I will use my own seed I kept from last year because improved bean seed is expensive and hard to find at the agro-dealer here. My grandchildren help me with weeding and I will do most of the work myself since the plot is small.
